summary: Events & tickets feature tested end-to-end on top of ARCHIVE LAB MVP. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (public events listing with registered_count/spots_left/sold_out, free register, duplicate 400, paid register creates kind='event' order + demo approve → registration 'pagada', capacity enforcement 409, /api/my/events auth 401 + authenticated results, admin RBAC 401/403/200, admin events CRUD, delete-with-paid blocked 400, pieces checkout regression still OK). Frontend: /eventos renders 2 seeded cards, 'ANOTARME' opens event-register-modal and shows '¡Listo! Quedaste anotada' toast; 'COMPRAR ENTRADA' navigates to /checkout/demo/{order_id}, demo-approve-button → /payment-result shows 'ENTRADA CONFIRMADA'. Admin /admin eventos tab lists events, event-regs-{id} opens Inscriptas modal, new-event-button opens event-editor with ev-title/ev-type/ev-price/ev-save present. Mi Archivo shows 'MIS EVENTOS' section with my-event-{id} card status ANOTADA.
critical_code_review_comments: event_public() computes registered_count via count_documents on every list/get call; cache or denormalize for scale, but fine for MVP.
mark_order_paid() for kind='event' doesn't notify the customer (no email/webhook). Acceptable for demo mode but worth adding later.
Admin DELETE /api/admin/events with paid tickets returns 400 but doesn't offer a 'force archive' option; UX hint in the error message is good.
server.py now ~1000 lines; splitting into routers (auth, catalog, checkout, events, admin) would improve maintainability.
No endpoint to CANCEL/REFUND an event registration — once 'pagada', only option is leaving it. For MVP OK.

seed_data_creation: Seed produces 2 events on startup (presentacion free capacity 25, desfile 18000 ARS capacity 40). Tests created ad-hoc events prefixed TEST_capacity_*/TEST_crud_* and TEST_* email registrations. TEST_crud_* event remains in DB in status='draft' (cannot delete due to a paid registration created by its own test, which is the expected 400 behaviour) — hidden from public /eventos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Events feature fully wired. Public /eventos uses data-testid event-card-{id}, event-register-{id}, event-register-modal, event-name, event-email, event-confirm. Payment result page uses CSS text-transform:uppercase so the string 'Entrada confirmada' is rendered as 'ENTRADA CONFIRMADA' — check case-insensitive. Running the CRUD test leaves one TEST_crud_* draft event with a paid registration behind by design (proves delete-with-paid guard). If re-running capacity test it will create+delete its own events. Backend MP_ACCESS_TOKEN still empty → demo mode is intentional.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. One cosmetic gotcha: payment-result renders 'ENTRADA CONFIRMADA' uppercase via CSS; initial exact-match substring assertion for 'Entrada confirmada' failed but the DOM is correct — screenshot confirmed.
